item.title: Analysis tutorial with Tableau Desktop
item.description: Tableau Desktop supports visual analysis and data discovery, converts the raw information to easy to understand graphical format with interactive charts. No coding is required to create rich visualization. Tableau Business Intelligence toolset has a Desktop, Server and Cloud version (none open-source products but as good as worth a post on the open-bigdata blog). In this post I check its Desktop evaluation version that lets us connect to many data sources (including Hadoop, MySQL, Excel, Text, …). I will use the same Weather.Csv as in the Hadoop analysis tutorial.
